title: Lot C, iii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. Wood draws the strip in Lot C on the steering wheel. The guard asks what he's doing. 'Auditing.' The guard writes it on the clipboard.

panels.composition: The Datsun in Lot C. WOOD drawing on a pad against the steering wheel. Rain on the windshield.
